d:
A reimagining of Guilty Gear: The Missing Link by featuring Domon and Rain from G-Gundam as they team up with Potemkin, whose "Heat Knuckle" and "Heat Extend" follow-up move are an hommage to Domon himself.

The last image featuring Domon and Rain in the ruins of Tokyo is a visual tribute to the best mellow song from G-Gundam, titled "Oritekita Yami".
n: [Misc] Guilty Gear x G-Gundam - HEAT EXTEND [AI GENERATED]
